title: Stadtwerk Mauer Municipality Public-Context Evidence Review seed

demoTenant.description: Virtual Stadtwerk Mauer demo tenant; municipality scope, grid-operator/market-actor public-context hints, source-freshness and review-readiness markers are invented review data. A bounded upstream timeout or degraded VNBdigital response is missing public-context evidence only and must never be read as an authoritative negative municipality, VNB or market-actor fact.

roleQuestion.question: Which municipality public-context evidence is present, missing or degraded right now, who owns the next review, and is a retry or connector call ever safe here?

publicContextLayer.description: Read-only public municipality, grid-operator and market-actor context sourced from the bounded municipal-energy-value-analysis brick. A degraded or timed-out upstream response stays inside this layer as missing evidence and must never become synthetic tenant master data or a resettable baseline replacement.

syntheticTenantSeed.description: Invented Stadtwerk-Mauer municipality scope, grid-operator/market-actor public-context hints, source-freshness and review-readiness markers.

sandboxRuntimeArtifact.description: Resettable output from Cernion/Rundeck or Workbench verification runs, separate from public context baselines.

roles.responsibility: Owns the operational decision boundary for whether municipality public-context evidence is review-ready or still needs clarification.
Verifies the Blueprint-Pack seed, matrix sync, no-call boundary and source API hint without creating runtime records.
Provides municipality scope, grid-operator and market-actor public-context hints without calling external connectors or asserting a confirmed assignment.
Provides source-freshness and review-readiness context without triggering a retry, escalation or public-context mutation.
Receives review-readiness status and missing-evidence context without approving any operational or market-actor decision.
Receives safety-boundary and evidence-gap context without MaKo, billing, settlement or tariff effects.

evidenceRequirements.enablesDossierAddition: Adds the municipality identity row before any public-context review.
Adds the complete postalCodes[] scope list, not just the first PLZ, so scope semantics stay complete.
Adds the read-only grid-operator/VNB public-context hint without asserting a confirmed market-actor assignment.
Adds the read-only market-actor public-context hint as metadata only, never as an authoritative market-actor binding.
Adds the checked-source freshness row once the bounded VNBdigital call returns; a timeout marks this evidence missing, never a negative municipality/VNB fact.
Adds the bounded degraded-retrieval marker so a 12s upstream timeout is visible as missing evidence instead of a silent gap.
Adds the review-ready or needs-clarification marker as read-only dossier status; remains missing/clarification while source evidence is degraded.
Adds the explicit no-retry/no-call boundary as read-only status, not as an operational or market-actor decision.
